title: Lab - Packet filtering
description: Open exactly the ports a web server needs.
scenario: Open exactly the ports a web server needs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Status
tasks.instructions: Which zone is the default and which services are allowed in it?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Allow
tasks.instructions: Allow http and https permanently and reload.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Port and source
tasks.solution:
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address=10.0.0.0/24 port port=8080 protocol=tcp accept'
firewall-cmd --reload
